page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a page number at the head left. No margin notes. Catchword "LATI," printed at the foot right, below the last line.

main_text.p: Lo vi menai, & velo menai, menailoui, Ich hab denselben daselbst hingeführt, ( illum illuc duxi. )
main_text.head: LO CI, vel CE LO.
main_text.p: ( Illum nobis ) denselben vns, Lo ci raccomando, over, Celo raccomando, idem raccomandolloci, & raccomandoccello, Er hat vns denselben gerühmbt, vnd befohlen, ( illum nobis commendavit. ) Idem io celo menai, & io menailoci, & menaicelo, hab denselben selbst hingeführt, ( illum illuc duxi. )
main_text.head: LO NE, vel NE LO.
main_text.p: ( Illum nobis ) denselben vns, Lo ne tolse, vel ne lo tolse, & tolsenole, vel tolsenelo, er hat jhn oder denselbigen vns hinweg genommen, ( illum nobis abstulit. )
Illum hinc, denselben hier, Lo ne meno vel nelo meno, menollene, & menonnelo, er hat jhn hinweg geführt, er hat jhn davon geführt, ( illum hinc abduxit. )
main_text.head: LA MI, vel ME LA.
main_text.p: ( Illam mihi ) Dieselbige mir, Me la raccomandasti, o La mi raccomandasti, & raccomandastime la, du hast sie mir anbefohlen, ( illam mihi commendasti. )

page.notes: Catchword "LATI," is at the foot right. Signatures and bleed-through marks at the left edge are not transcribed. Several Italian-style words are printed with irregular spelling and are copied as printed.
